description: The shape found on a live Ubuntu 24.04 workstation, which used to produce UNKNOWN. Two files in ONE directory set kernel.sysrq to different values — 0x01b6 in 50-default.conf and 176 in 55-magic-sysrq.conf — and both procps and systemd-sysctl resolve that identically: later filename wins, so 176. Flagging it as a conflict was over-caution, and the running kernel on that host confirms 176. The hex value is deliberate: it also exercises the base-0 parse.
